page.overview:
What is Kirimise?

Kirimise belongs to Demon Slayer. Attempting to inform her husband, Hinatsuru poisoned herself in order to escape Daki's surveillance and is sent to one of the Kirimise Houses as an attempt to escape.

However, Daki's obi held Hinatsuru hostage and she is left unable to escape. After interrogating the master of the Kyogoku House for her whereabouts, Tengen Uzui enters the Kirimise and is able to locate Hinatsuru, ill and still bound in the obi. He cuts her free and gives her an antidote, whilst she explains why she was unable to contact him.
